Coram : DALVEER BHANDARI*, DEEPAK VERMA
Service Law: c Time-bound promotional scale - Entitlement to - Held: The Circular of the Authority and service Regulations provided for time-bound promotional scale only to directly recruited Assistant Engineers/Assistant Executive Engineers or to those who had acquired the requisite direct recruitment - The order and the Regulations are not applicable to promotees irrespective of their academic qualification - Promotees cannot be treated at par with the direct recruits as the same would amount to violation of Arlie/es 14 and 16 of the Constitution - PSEB, Service of E
Decision Date : 19-08-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3439/2007 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
